statement: No ground motion above the noise was detected over London in this one-season provisional NISAR chain (21 Jun - 19 Oct 2026, 9 pairs): after removing residual long-wavelength atmosphere, 98 % of 1 km areas lie within +/-1.5 cm and no area away from the scene edge exceeds the 3-sigma threshold of 3.6 cm. Seasonal clay shrinkage of about a centimetre or less would be below what this chain can resolve.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
notes: Study box (-0.5, 51.3, 0.2, 51.7) as defined by PC2 in pipeline/search.py; track 101 ascending frame 28. Maps in data/uk_clay/disp/ are real data but should be labelled 'below detection'.
